comment: The expander must be the module immediately to the right of SYNC3XL: onExpanderChange checks that its left neighbour is modelSync3XL (src/sync3xllevels.cpp:129-135). The level it computes is the knob times 5V plus the CV, clamped to 0-10V and scaled by 0.2, so the knob alone reaches a gain of 1 and the CV can take it to 2. The negative half of a CV is clamped away by the 0V floor. The panel artwork is a wireframe outline; the only lettering on it is '0 - 1'.
